$comment: How autopilot founders treat people (D-064, core/Autopilot.cpp). They greet a person they meet, once per person per game day (by name only if they know them), and sometimes start a chat with someone they know: the chance is base + per_trait x their trait/100 + per_friendship x their friendship/100, rolled once per person per day. Asks are answered by these rules from their own side of the relationship; a kind with no rule is declined, and intimacy is never accepted (the loader refuses a rule for it). People only: never other autopilot founders or scripts.
